name: s81b-wsrc-pinroot-605d751a5-hm10
purpose: Root boundary fix: per-pin input/output flop anchoring; legal lower IO layers (M4/M6 and M5/M7), clock at W-face midpoint. Same hash-verified MARGIN2 RTL and existing four writer cycles. Historical HM10 actual failures: 15 input captures, FF -7.63, r2r +2.99; never mask with higher repair margin. Source reference core is local edge origin, virtual clock measured interior insertion. TT setup>=0 FF hold>=0 DRC0 option B; SS sensitivity retained.

bench.name: request-skid-exact-mutant
bench.pass_regex: PASS source-manifest and production W339 skid positive/mutant

calibrate.cmd: export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; OT_MM_FF_SDC="physical/dsrom_window_source/cl_{LABEL}${CL_LABEL_SUFFIX}/signoff_ss.sdc physical/dsrom_window_source/cl_{LABEL}${CL_LABEL_SUFFIX}/signoff_ff_guarded.sdc" SRC={SRC} OUT={RUN}/routes CORES=16 DIE=540 PD=0.50 MARGIN=2 physical/dsrom_window_source/route_ctl.sh {LABEL}${CL_LABEL_SUFFIX} $CL_STOP_AFTER
calibrate.sdc_cmd: echo route_ctl.sh writes the IO SDC from CK_SS_MEAN/CK_FF_MIN/CK_FF_MAX

route.cmd: export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; OT_MM_FF_SDC="physical/dsrom_window_source/cl_{LABEL}${CL_LABEL_SUFFIX}/signoff_ss.sdc physical/dsrom_window_source/cl_{LABEL}${CL_LABEL_SUFFIX}/signoff_ff_guarded.sdc" SRC={SRC} OUT={RUN}/routes CORES=16 DIE=540 PD=0.50 MARGIN=2 physical/dsrom_window_source/route_ctl.sh {LABEL}

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record && cp -r {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/view {RUN}/record/ && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/args {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/*.sdc {RUN}/record/ && cp {CL}/calib.json {RUN}/record/calib.json && cp {RUN}/bench/*.log {RUN}/record/ && cp {SRC}/physical/dsrom_window_source/root_fix.json {SRC}/physical/dsrom_window_source/model_pin_anchor.json {RUN}/record/
